name: skill-watch
description: Skill telemetry, drift detection, and self-improvement loop for bokendell Codex workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Improves local agent skills from real deviations
interface.longDescription: Records expected skills, missed standards, validation gaps, and recurring drift, then proposes or applies reviewable skill updates in the local skills-marketplace checkout.
